title: Claude-style usage reports for NemoClaw Hermes sessions

scope_decision.authority: User-authorized experiment in Ali-Maq fork; no NVIDIA approval or support implied
scope_decision.reason: Inspect measured model usage without exporting conversation content
scope_decision.compatibility: Hermes SQLite sessions metadata; missing optional counters remain unknown
scope_decision.lifecycle: Read-only inspection; no sandbox start, restart, configuration changes, or provider requests

requirements: Use the existing NemoClaw OpenShell buffered command executor and named gateway from registry. Reject non-Hermes or unregistered sandboxes. Do not alter sandbox lifecycle or gateway selection.
Read the Hermes sessions table with sqlite mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only. Use HERMES_HOME or /sandbox/.hermes. No messages, prompts, paths, credentials or response text in output.
All sessions by default, or exact --session ID. --include-children only with --session, includes all descendants once, handles cycles without hanging. Unknown session must fail.

Python script exported as HERMES_USAGE_SCRIPT from hermes-usage-script.ts. Invoked with python3 -c SCRIPT, database path argv[1], requested session argv[2] (empty means all), include children argv[3] (1 or 0). No shell interpolation.

Stable JSON fields: schema_version=1, session_count integer, totals {api_calls,input_tokens,output_tokens,tool_calls} number|null, models array of {model,provider,session_count,api_calls,input_tokens,output_tokens,tool_calls}, incomplete_fields array of counter names, cost_usd=null. Host adds sandbox. Sort models by model then provider. Missing model/provider -> unknown.

Counter mappings: api_call_count->api_calls, tool_call_count->tool_calls. Missing column or NULL counter means unknown, not zero; affected total and affected model total must be null and appear in incomplete_fields. Empty selection all database -> 0 counts. Reject negative, noninteger or unsafe JS integer counters and overflowing totals.
Model grouping uses session metadata, not per-call attribution; report this limitation in text help. Cost is unavailable; do not invent a price.
Bound remote execution to 20 seconds, capture <=1 MiB; enforce 10000-session limit with explicit error instead of truncating. Errors must not dump raw database or transport content.
Human text shows sessions, calls, input/output tokens and unavailable cost; JSON stdout must contain only JSON. Reject unknown flags or extra positionals.

Implement focused Vitest tests using real temporary SQLite databases via Python. Cover empty store, known totals, filtered parent+children, unknown or malformed schema, NULL, missing counters, cycles, corrupt/negative counters, and absence of prompt/secret content. Tests may inject a transport for command assertions; live proof must use actual installed sandbox.
validation: Independent host evaluator uses hidden SQLite cases, source review, TypeScript build, CLI routing/help, real read-only sandbox execution and separate database aggregate comparison.
